svg.title: Johansson Heights Minato · typical floor plan
svg.text: Six flats a floor off an open corridor; the lift and stair on its west side; balconies to the sea.
302 B · Mrs Higa, Higa Kenta (connects to 301)
304 B · Mrs Kinjō, Kinjo Yui (connects to 303)
ヨハンソンハイツ港町
Flats 3.42 × 7 m inside (23.94 m²) and a 1.13 m balcony. Odd flats have their shaft
(PS/MB) on the north wall, even flats on the south: two flats share each shaft.
Balcony partitions are breakable boards (dashed); columns 600 × 600 on B and C every
